name: Inditex
notes: Revenue = Net sales (Ventas). Operating income = EBIT (Resultado/Beneficio de explotación; 'Net operating profit (EBIT)'). FY runs Feb 1 - Jan 31; Inditex labels FY by start year (FY2025 ends 2026-01-31). FY1999-FY2003 Spanish GAAP; FY2004+ IFRS (FY2004 IFRS-restated 5,569/922 vs Spanish GAAP 5,670/925). FY2019+ IFRS 16 (FY2018 not restated). FY1999-FY2011 figures from Inditex annual reports retrieved from the UAB library archive of company reports (ddd.uab.cat), not from inditex.com. FY2012-2015 converted from thousands, rounded.
